record.oneLiner: A tiny, early omnivorous dinosaur near the dawn of the group.
record.description: Eoraptor was a small, lightly built early sauropodomorph of the Late Triassic of Argentina and one of the earliest known dinosaurs. Its varied tooth shapes suggest it was omnivorous.

notableFacts.text: One of the earliest known dinosaurs.
Its mix of tooth shapes points to an omnivorous diet.
